title: Fault Detection in Solar Thermal Systems using Probabilistic Reconstructions
abstract: arXiv:2511.10296v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Solar thermal systems (STS) present a promising avenue for low-carbon heat generation, with a well-running system providing heat at minimal cost and carbon emissions. However, STS can exhibit faults due to improper installation, maintenance, or operation, often resulting in a substantial reduction in efficiency or even damage to the system. As monitoring at the individual level is economically prohibitive for small-scale systems, automated monitoring and fault detection should be used to address such issues. Recent advances in data-driven anomaly detection, particularly in time series analysis, offer a cost-effective solution by leveraging existing sensors to identify abnormal system states. Here, we apply probabilistic reconstruction-based anomaly detection to the publicly available PaSTS dataset of operational domestic STS, which features real-world complexities and diverse fault types. translated_title: 基于概率重构的太阳能热系统故障检测
translated_abstract: 太阳能热系统为低碳供热提供了一条极具前景的途径，一个运行良好的系统能够以最低的成本和碳排放提供热量。然而，太阳能热系统可能因安装、维护或操作不当而出现故障，往往导致效率大幅下降甚至系统损坏。由于对小型系统进行逐个监控在经济上不可行，因此应采用自动化监控和故障检测来解决此类问题。数据驱动异常检测的最新进展，尤其是时间序列分析方面的进展，通过利用现有传感器识别异常系统状态，提供了一种经济高效的解决方案。本文将基于概率重构的异常检测方法应用于公开可用的PaSTS数据集，该数据集包含实际运行中的家用太阳能热系统，具有真实世界的复杂性和多样化的故障类型。我们结合了基于LSTM的变分自编码器……
tldr: 该论文提出将基于概率重构（LSTM变分自编码器）的异常检测方法应用于真实运行的家用太阳能热系统公开数据集，实现经济高效的自动化故障检测。
